HomePage.title: Genzia
HomePage.badge: Agent as a Service for marketing agencies
HomePage.headline: The AI agent that runs your agency, not just organizes it
HomePage.subtitle: Scheduling, content, billing, and client communication — over WhatsApp, with your agency's brand. Drop the scattered WhatsApp + spreadsheets and hand the daily operation to an agent that actually runs it.
HomePage.featuresHeading: Every client's full context, in one place

clients.title: Centralized clients
clients.description: Add, look up, and search clients by chat or form — no more scattered records across chats and spreadsheets.

calendar.title: Scheduling and content
calendar.description: Book shoot dates, plan content, and get automatic reminders before a deadline slips.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Recurring or per-project plans, payment-link reminders, and real confirmation — never inferred from chat.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp, your brand
whatsapp.description: The agent replies on the number your clients already know, with the name and tone you give it — no visible platform behind it.

HomePage.footerNote: Multi-tenant, multilingual from day one — Spanish and English.
